title: Interactive postcard assets for secure API onboarding: keys, streaming, and tool-call snapshots
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, modular set of onboarding visual assets ("postcard" cards and micro-canvases) for the API/SDK quickstart that demonstrate: secure key provisioning, streaming responses, and example tool-calls. Assets should be usable as in-doc screenshots, small animated GIFs for the docs header, and component-level slices for the docs site and SDK onboarding modal.
acceptance_criteria: Four unique postcard layouts: key creation, key rotation, streaming sample, and tool-call flow
Each layout exported at 3 sizes: doc hero (1200x600), inline screenshot (740x320), and thumbnail (360x180)
Accessible color variants for light/dark mode and WCAG AA contrast compliance
Figma file shared with tokens and component slices; production-ready PNG/JPG/MP4/GIF exports in Drive
A short developer-facing caption for each asset explaining the code snippet and expected runtime behavior
assets: FIGMA: 'Postcard - Streaming Example' (live-stream wire + code overlay)
Exports: PNG hero / PNG inline / GIF micro-animate / MP4 short-preview
attachments: GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/784 - docs examples referencing new assets
